id=Puerto Kayo: Dead Sun Expanse

Puerto Kayo is a massive custom map centered around a historic colonial settlement surrounded by scorching sands, forgotten ruins, sprawling cave networks, and mysterious cloning facilities hidden beneath the earth.
Whether you choose to survive as an ordinary citizen or emerge from a classified cloning vault, every playthrough offers new player-built stories, challenges, and opportunities to build your legacy.
Features
• 72 new cells to explore, offering 300+ hours of gameplay
• Start as a Clone within the subterranean Cloning Vaults, or begin as a traditional survivor within Puerto Kayo
• Cloning Vault starts are designed as a challenging survival combat experience
• Play as the unique Genetic Experiment class
• Custom clone-themed outfits and traits
• Explore, settle, defend, or rebuild the historic colonial city of Puerto Kayo
• Discover and inhabit El Guardia, a national historic settlement preserved within the desert
• Venture into 20+ massive cave systems hidden beneath the sands
• Raid and conquer a massive 12-cell island
• Multiplayer-optimized claimable mansions designed with chunk-rot resistance in mind
• Custom-tailored tiles, environments, and world design unique to Puerto Kayo
A Different Kind of Apocalypse
Far from the forests and suburbs of Kentucky lies a forgotten region where blistering heat, stone settlements, and hidden biotechnology facilities create a completely different survival experience.
Beneath the sands, abandoned cloning vaults preserve humanity's last and greatest genetic archives.
Above them, entire settlements wait to be reclaimed.
The question is simple:
Will you survive Puerto Kayo...or become part of its history?
